newsitem.title: USA: Whittaker pushes profit forecast to FY97.
newsitem.headline: Whittaker pushes profit forecast to FY97.

text.p: Whittaker Corp said on Tuesday it foresaw a return to profitability in fiscal 1997 instead of the fourth quarter of 1996.

In a statement, the company reported net loss for the third quarter of $5.9 million, or $0.54 per share, after a one-time charge of $866,000, or $0.5 per share, for restructuring. The company had a profit of $1.75 million, or $0.18 a share, in the same quarter of 1995. The period ended on July 31.

Whittaker has told its bank lending group that it is not in compliance with a financial ratio covenant in its credit agreement. The company is discussing with its bank group a waiver and an amendment to the agreement.

"We are now seeing the improvements expected from the changes we made, and we remain committed to our strategy to develop our key communications technologies for future growth," said Thomas A. Brancati, president and chief executive.
The statement said, "With these improvements, Whittaker Corp now expects its return to profitability in fiscal 1997 rather than the fourth quarter as previously noted."
